name: @ui8kit/codegen
description: Spec-driven codegen for UI8Kit primitives: 17 style-agnostic HTML primitives, one typed render contract, five JS runtimes (React, Svelte 5, Vue 3, SolidJS, vanilla Web Components) plus Go templ and Jinja2.

scripts.typecheck:generated: bun run generate && bun x tsc -p tsconfig.generated.json && bun x tsc -p tsconfig.generated.solid.json && bun x vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.generated.vue.json && bun x svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.generated.svelte.json --fail-on-warnings
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run generate && bun run docs:check && bun x tsc --noEmit && bun run typecheck:generated && bun test
